ex.en: He urgently needs to find work.
ex.zh: 他急需找到工作。

ex.en: We urgently need more staff.
ex.zh: 我們急需更多人手。

ex.en: The manager wants to see you urgently.
ex.zh: 經理有急事要見你。

ex.en: Uranium is used as fuel in nuclear power plants.
ex.zh: 鈾被用作核電廠的燃料。

ex.en: The country has large uranium deposits.
ex.zh: 這個國家有大量的鈾礦藏。

ex.en: I urge you to tell him the truth.
ex.zh: 我勸你告訴他實話。

ex.en: Lawyers will urge the parents to take further legal action.
ex.zh: 律師們會力勸家長採取進一步的法律行動。

ex.en: We urge all passengers to arrive early.
ex.zh: 我們呼籲所有旅客提早抵達。

ex.en: I had a sudden urge to eat chocolate.
ex.zh: 我突然很想吃巧克力。

ex.en: She resisted the urge to check her phone.
ex.zh: 她忍住了想看手機的衝動。

ex.en: More and more people are moving to urban areas.
ex.zh: 越來越多人搬到都市地區。

ex.en: Traffic is a major urban problem.
ex.zh: 交通是都市的一大問題。

ex.en: An increase in the number of cars will affect the urban environment.
ex.zh: 汽車數量增加會影響都市環境。

ex.en: We want to analyze your urine.
ex.zh: 我們要幫您驗尿。

ex.en: My urine is clear.
ex.zh: 我的尿液很清澈。

ex.en: The doctor asked for a urine sample.
ex.zh: 醫生要我提供尿液檢體。

ex.en: This matter is of incredible urgency!
ex.zh: 這件事十萬火急！

ex.en: The manager stressed the urgency of the situation.
ex.zh: 經理強調情況的急迫性。

ex.en: We need to act with a sense of urgency.
ex.zh: 我們需要抱著急迫感採取行動。

ex.en: This matter is very urgent.
ex.zh: 這件事非常緊急。

ex.en: There is an urgent message for you.
ex.zh: 你有一個緊急的訊息。

ex.en: There is an urgent need for medical supplies.
ex.zh: 現在急需醫療用品。
